keyFindings.description: Line 43 builds in place, and line 27 and README.md:270 present it as the required check's command. Run locally on a pull request's tree (reproduced by the tester and both thermonuclear agents in scratch clones: a skills edit, then verify-build, leaves M packages/claude-envoy/legion/skills/... and jj st lists it in @), it rewrites tracked dist/ and legion/ into the pull request's commit, the conflict INFRA-630 removes; a relative <tar> lands untracked in packages/claude-envoy too. The plan's design was that nothing a pull request runs writes the tracked files. Required: verify-build leaves tracked files untouched by default (build into a scratch directory or restore, refuse a <tar> inside the repository), only the rebuild workflow writes the checkout (extract the checked tar, or an explicit flag pull-request jobs never pass), and the second build's failure says two builds differed rather than 'stale'. Proof: jj status clean after each documented local command.

Lines 255-257 tell an operator to refresh a main checkout with bun scripts/build.ts --in-place during the lag; that leaves tracked files modified, and the next git pull over the rebuild commit is refused ('Your local changes ... would be overwritten'). Point LEGION_CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DIR at an --out build for that window, or say to restore the two directories before pulling.
